read.thesis: Duke Q2 adjusted EPS $1.43 vs $1.25 a year ago; 2026 guidance $6.55–6.80 reaffirmed, but this is a regulated utility with rate-base growth, not a supply-cycle name, so the read is steady earnings, no capacity signal.
